parameters.description: Accepts the canonical email contract from the Gmail adapter or test harness.

nodes.name: Idempotency Check
nodes.notes: Message-ID idempotency: checks email_events by idempotency_key (mailbox:message-id). Duplicates stop here.

nodes.name: Return Duplicate Stop
nodes.notes: Terminal: duplicate delivery creates no duplicate side effects (P2-E2E-005).

nodes.name: Deterministic Rules
nodes.notes: Deterministic rules BEFORE AI: VIP sender/domain, newsletter/promotion, and blocked-sender classification. Blocked senders stop; newsletter and VIP labels are passed to the triage core. Config lives in this Code node (swappable per client).

nodes.name: Write Blocked Event
nodes.notes: Blocked sender: audited and stopped. No triage, draft, task, or alert.

nodes.name: Write email_events
nodes.notes: Writes the email_events record with processing_status: received before triage. The record id flows forward as email_event_id.

parameters.jsCode:
const ev = $('Write email_events').first().json || {};
const j = $('Deterministic Rules').item.json;
return [{ json: {
  correlation_id: j.correlation_id,
  idempotency_key: j.idempotency_key,
  email_event_id: ev.id || '',
  mailbox: j.mailbox,
  message_id: j.message_id,
  thread_id: j.thread_id,
  from_name: j.from_name,
  from_email: j.from_email,
  to: j.to,
  subject: j.subject,
  text_body: j.text_body,
  received_at: j.received_at,
  attachment_metadata: j.attachment_metadata,
  source_link: j.source_link,
  rules: j.rules
}}];

nodes.name: Call Triage Core
nodes.notes: After import, bind this node to P2-02 AI Triage and Draft Core workflow ID. The public export uses a placeholder workflow ID.

nodes.name: Call Review & Task Handoff
nodes.notes: After import, bind this node to P2-03 Review and Task Handoff workflow ID. Called for every triaged message (accepted and review_required); P2-03 decides which side effects to create. The public export uses a placeholder workflow ID.

value.last_error_code: ={{ $('Call Review & Task Handoff').item.json.task_error_code || $('Call Review & Task Handoff').item.json.draft_error || $('Call Review & Task Handoff').item.json.alert_error || '' }}

nodes.name: Update email_events Final State
nodes.notes: Updates email_events with triage category/importance/confidence, handoff draft_id/task_id, and final processing_status. External-write states (draft_id, task_id) are written only after the handoff returns.

parameters.jsCode:
const email = $('Prepare Triage Input').item.json;
const triage = $('Call Triage Core').first().json || {};
const handoff = $('Call Review & Task Handoff').first().json || {};
return [{ json: {
  correlation_id: email.correlation_id,
  idempotency_key: email.idempotency_key,
  message_id: email.message_id,
  email_event_id: email.email_event_id,
  outcome: triage.review_required ? 'review_required' : 'processed',
  category: triage.category || '',
  importance: triage.importance || '',
  needs_reply: !!triage.needs_reply,
  needs_task: !!triage.needs_task,
  sensitive: !!triage.sensitive,
  confidence: triage.confidence,
  draft_id: handoff.draft_id || '',
  draft_error: handoff.draft_error || '',
  task_id: handoff.task_id || '',
  task_status: handoff.task_status || '',
  task_error_code: handoff.task_error_code || '',
  alert_sent: !!handoff.alert_sent,
  alert_error: handoff.alert_error || '',
  review_queue_id: triage.review_queue_id || handoff.review_queue_id || '',
  final_status: triage.review_required ? 'review_required_no_external_actions' : (handoff.final_status || 'handoff_unknown')
}}];
